title: Minimum Number of Primes to Sum to Target
summary: Given the integers n and m , select a multiset of prime numbers from the first m prime numbers such that the sum of the selected primes equals n .
statement: Given the integers n and m , select a multiset of prime numbers from the first m prime numbers such that the sum of the selected primes equals n . You may use each prime number multiple times. Return the minimum number of prime numbers needed to achieve this sum, or return -1 if it is not possible.
constraints: Target n is one to 1000 and m is one to 1000.
Use any of the first m primes any number of times.
Return the minimum count summing exactly to n, or -1.
hints: The first m primes act like reusable coin denominations.
Generate the primes, then run unbounded minimum-coin DP.
Scan totals upward for each prime and relax count from total-prime.
Upward scans permit reuse, and every multiset has a final selected prime represented by a relaxation.
editorial: Upward scans permit reuse, and every multiset has a final selected prime represented by a relaxation.
